scope: VIGIL3 native consumer snapshots, pending-read rejection, coherent lookup caches, recovery inspection, and CLI/MCP package qualification.

current_evidence.final_review: All 161 tests and eleven verification steps pass. Recorded source/artifact hashes match. Wheel contains snapshot support and excludes tests and keys. Synthetic qualification-workshop hashes match the nine-script-call record. Installed workshop MCP rejects pending queries, blocks cache rebuild, and resumes queries after actual CLI recovery.
current_evidence.authority: Execution records distinguish local implementation and installed protocol evidence from live model, remote CI, and host acceptance.
current_evidence.environment: Windows CPython 3.13.9; native/test fixtures on C:, dependency/type-check caches and installed-wheel runtime on E:.

closed_findings.finding: Empty framework modules, absent application entry points, empty README, and launchers naming a missing cipher.py.
closed_findings.resolution: Installable 0.2.0 package with vigiles/bamboozle/module entry points, packaged dictionary and taxonomies, working batch launchers, and operating documentation.

closed_findings.finding: Sequential replacement and ambiguous case could corrupt reversible translation.
closed_findings.resolution: Validated immutable dictionary, longest-first single-pass translation, protected literal targets, bounded expansion, and exact round-trip enforcement.

closed_findings.finding: Global ledgers coupled unrelated files and could conceal incomplete publication.
closed_findings.resolution: Per-file mapping snapshots and digests, stale-input rejection, source preservation, exclusive publication, honest partial-write reports, exact-pair recovery, and ledger size checks.

closed_findings.finding: Repository operations lacked a shared path and integrity boundary.
closed_findings.resolution: Explicit workspace confinement rejects escapes, links, junctions, alternate streams, and protected output locations. Explicit baselines and read-only audits/watch report structural drift.
closed_findings.limitation: Application checks do not replace OS isolation against hostile concurrent directory replacement.

closed_findings.finding: Terminology substitution provided no confidential exchange mechanism.
closed_findings.resolution: Tessera AES-256-GCM packets authenticate headers and recipient labels, preserve binary payloads, reject tampering, and use separately generated keys.
closed_findings.limitation: Recipient identity, key distribution, revocation, and replay controls remain VIG-IDENTITY-01.

closed_findings.finding: Agent interaction had no shared native conversion contract.
closed_findings.resolution: Five stdio MCP tools use shared services; writes require a bounded, expiring, single-use preview token and fresh source checks.

closed_findings.finding: Workshop paths were host-specific, taxonomy shapes diverged, and indexes could remain stale or silently omit undecodable data.
closed_findings.resolution: Environment-based paths, packaged taxonomy fallback, common schema validation, lazy plaintext alias keys, content/key fingerprints, preserved forced-rotation key backups, and explicit missing-pipeline status.

closed_findings.finding: Exclusive publication assumed Windows hard-link support on all volumes.
closed_findings.resolution: Windows uses native no-overwrite rename; POSIX uses exclusive hard-link publication. Installed runtime exercises ordinary writes on the alternate Windows volume.

closed_findings.finding: No reproducible separation of source checks, runtime tests, and installed-package qualification.
closed_findings.resolution: Locked dev/runtime dependencies, a verification runner with retained logs and hashes, clean wheel smoke, and a Windows/Linux Python 3.13/3.14 CI definition.

closed_findings.finding: Duplicated workshop runners raised unstructured timeout/start errors, had no dependency preflight, and resolved venv interpreter symlinks to base Python.
closed_findings.resolution: Shared script adapter, non-executing readiness checks, script digests, failure/timeout reporting, preserved interpreter paths, and isolated subprocess contract tests.
closed_findings.limitation: Authoritative LoRA promotion, quarantine, audit, and recovery qualification remains VIG-DEPLOY-01.

closed_findings.finding: The authoritative promotion/quarantine/audit implementation and operational workshop were absent; the archived promote.py was only a metadata helper.
closed_findings.resolution: Repository-native implementations, initialization, representative candidates/manifest/matrix, and a persistent synthetic qualification workshop now exist.

closed_findings.finding: Multi-file pipeline writes needed recoverable partial-publication semantics and protection against stale plans.
closed_findings.resolution: OS file locking, pre-write journals with before-images, content-state checks, verified copy-before-removal quarantine, explicit recovery, and digest-bound completion records.

closed_findings.finding: Native consumers and cached indexes could expose interrupted metadata publication; status rebuilt before checking recovery.
closed_findings.resolution: Read-only snapshots validate the same completed journal set around capture. Pending operations reject queries/new plans and block index rebuild while recovery status remains available.

closed_findings.finding: Index fingerprints/key usage and stack matrix lookups could mix revisions; native lookup omitted tags used by audit.
closed_findings.resolution: Build/fingerprint/encrypt from captured bytes, retain the snapshot cipher and matrix, select the native workshop key, and include tags for native lookup.

closed_findings.finding: Installed relative workshop readiness exposed doubled resolution of snapshot paths.
closed_findings.resolution: Resolve supplied filesystem Paths from the process cwd before workspace confinement. Added relative-path regression and repeated full installed qualification.

retained_failures.failure: Wheel dependency extraction failed with OS error 112 because C: ran out of space.
retained_failures.unaffected_evidence: Source checks, 95 tests, and wheel/sdist build passed in this run.
retained_failures.remediation: Cleared only the task-created repository uv cache; moved new cache, build temporary files, and isolated package runtime to E:.
retained_failures.residual: C: remains low on free space. Use the documented scratch/cache overrides for further packaging.

retained_failures.failure: The first alternate-volume run exposed unsupported hard links and unsupported junction fixtures; 31 tests failed and 64 passed.
retained_failures.remediation: Replaced Windows hard-link publication with exclusive rename. Kept link-confinement fixtures on C: and package runtime on E:.
retained_failures.evidence_rule: Retained failed execution history is not a current passing result.

retained_failures.failure: Final verification found Ruff ISC004 in the newly added interpreter regression probe; package qualification was correctly not attempted.
retained_failures.unaffected_evidence: 120 tests, Mypy, Pyright, formatting, and compilation passed.
retained_failures.remediation: Made the intentional multiline probe string concatenation explicit and reran the complete verification including package installation.

retained_failures.failure: The 0.3.0 full run encountered C: disk exhaustion (OS error 28) and a Mypy internal error. Pytest recorded 129 passes, 4 failures, and 10 setup errors; packaging was not attempted.
retained_failures.remediation: Preserved the 113 MB repository Mypy cache on E: and set MYPY_CACHE_DIR there for the retry. Logs and failed tests remain retained. No source or qualification assets were deleted.

retained_failures.failure: The first 0.3.1 package smoke failed workshop-check for a relative workshop path.
retained_failures.unaffected_evidence: All 159 source tests, lint/types, builds, and isolated installation passed in that run.
retained_failures.remediation: Corrected snapshot path resolution, added relative-root and selected-native-key regressions; all 161 tests and full installed qualification then passed.

delivery_boundaries: No commit, push, external MCP client registration, or remote deployment performed.

Only explicitly labeled synthetic assets were promoted/quarantined in the local qualification workspace. No live model execution, automatic quarantine, process termination policy, or startup service installation was performed.
Unkeyed ledgers and local audit baselines establish consistency, not independent authenticity.
Historical design documents are not runtime guarantees.

active_step.authority: User requested v0.3.1 (VIGIL3), REVIEW -> PLAN -> DEVELOP -> REPEAT.
review_findings: Readers could consume partially published metadata and poison index caches.
Cached MCP indexes bypassed pending checks; status rebuilt before inspecting recovery.
Stack queries could combine an index and matrix from different revisions.
plan: Fence bounded snapshots with the native completed journal set.
Build and query indexes from the same captured bytes, including their cipher and matrix.
Keep recovery status available and reject pending data queries without mutation.
Verify interruption/concurrency, real installed MCP, and preserved foundation evidence.
active_step.remaining_boundary: Live model, ComfyUI, remote CI, identity, restore migration, and host qualification remain open.
completed_work: Journal-fenced native snapshots reject incomplete or concurrently published reads without mutation.
MCP and lookup revalidate pending status even when an in-memory or disk cache exists.
Index content, encryption key, and matrix belong to one snapshot; native tags match audit inputs.
Recovery inspection remains available with readable status and explicit rebuild outcome.
Eighteen additional regressions and installed workshop MCP pending/recovery evidence pass.
Version 0.3.1 packages, updated native specification, and preserved foundation/failure records are supplied.
active_step.next_action: Review and implement bounded external subprocess output capture, preserving timeout/nonzero-exit progress and partial-publication evidence. Host process-tree isolation and live model acceptance remain separate gates.

environment_remediation_0.3.1.issue: C: reached zero free bytes during development; editor Mypy cache had reappeared.
environment_remediation_0.3.1.action: Preserved the 70 MiB cache on E: and created a .mypy_cache junction at its original path.

next_step.finding: run_script truncates returned tails but subprocess.run(capture_output=True) still buffers complete child stdout/stderr in memory.
done_criteria: Hard bounds on retained stdout/stderr while continuously draining child pipes
Correct byte-tail and truncation reporting for successful, failed, and timed-out scripts
No deadlock when both streams are noisy
Captured progress and partial files retained; no automatic retry or rollback
Installed adapter regression evidence on the local platform
boundaries: Direct-child termination is the current contract; process-tree isolation requires a separate host policy.
No live model qualification is inferred from subprocess fixtures.
